A bisht atelier in Kuwait City · est. 1994

Cut by hand. Worn for a lifetime.

Camel-hair cloth from Najd, gold zari couched by hand along every edge, two fittings, and a bisht ready in twenty-one days. One master cutter, three tailors, and a book of four thousand fittings since 1994.

Start your fittingSee the cloth

Scroll, and the sheets turn.

01 · The cloth

Four cloths, one loom, no blend.

Pure camel hair, spun and woven for us on one loom in Najd, in four colours we have never changed: ivory, sand, walnut and black. It weighs 340 grams a metre, breathes in August, and softens for forty years.

340 ga metre, pure camel hair
4colours, never changed
1loom, in Najd

02 · The zari

Eleven metres of gold, laid by one pair of hands.

The zari is a gold-wrapped silk cord couched onto the edge by hand, four stitches to the centimetre, from the collar down both fronts and around the cuffs. One tailor lays the whole eleven metres; it takes him six days. Silver zari is the same cord, the same hands, the same six days.

11 mof cord on every bisht
4stitches to the centimetre
6days, one pair of hands

03 · Your fitting

Choose the cloth, the zari and the length. Then tell us three numbers.

The bisht on the form changes with your cloth and your zari. Your height, your shoulders and your chest give us the drop, the sleeve and the sweep; the first fitting checks them on you.

04 · The atelier

One cutting table, three tailors, four thousand fittings.

The master cuts every bisht himself on the long table under the window. Three tailors sew and lay the zari. Nothing leaves the room until he has seen it on you twice.

1994the year the table came in

05 · Twenty-one days

From the first fitting to the box, in three weeks.

  1. 1The first fittingDay 1. Your numbers on you, the cloth in your hands, the length walked in.
  2. 2The cutDays 2–4. The master cuts; the fronts and sleeves are basted for you to try.
  3. 3The zariDays 5–11. Eleven metres, one pair of hands, six days.
  4. 4The second fitting and the boxDays 12–21. Pressed, boxed, and yours — or altered once more at no charge.

06 · Visit

Come and hold the cloth.

By appointment, and the first fitting takes forty minutes. Bring the occasion, not the answers: the cloth, the zari and the length are easier to choose with them in your hands.
